_comment: The Lean-to-manuscript census registry read by tools/lean_manuscript_census.py. Every OIBridge module belongs to exactly one family; every family carries a disposition; a family the manuscripts carry (current, consistent-uncited, scope-consistent) names at least one anchor; a superseded identifier may appear in a manuscript paragraph only alongside its successor. Registry contract (AGENTS.md A.35): the check is complete relative to this file, so every publication-facing strengthening of a theorem inside an existing module updates this file in the same commit, with a supersession entry for the identifier it replaces and an anchor for the statement the manuscripts must now carry.

families.name: representation bridge and counting
families.note: The cubic counting layer of the SM paper: Theorem 7 (the six-link decomposition, theorem_7 with the projector dimensions and the T1 character), the averaging identity and the equivariant-map dimension formula at its proof (card_mul_finrank_invariants, finrank_intertwiners), Corollary 1a (ohInvariant_iff, rem_littleO, rem_bigO), Theorem 8 (theorem_8), Theorem 16 (theorem_16). Kernel pointers are placed at the proof paragraphs that follow the statements, the statement lines untouched; the paper's own derivations are unchanged.

families.name: equivalence chain and memory
families.note: Main 3.4 with kernel pointers at the proof or list paragraphs that follow the statements, the statement lines untouched: the finite-horizon stochastic-reversible-unitary equivalence (finite_horizon_equivalence, S_imp_D; permMatrix_mem_unitaryGroup, isDiag_Phi of EquivalenceChain), the process dilation (S_imp_D), C3 necessity and the per-process capacity bound (c3_necessity, card_hidden_ge_two_pow_Istar, c3_necessity_and_capacity), unavoidable hidden predictive memory (unavoidable_hidden_predictive_memory, distinguishability_floor, capacity_floor), the separability threshold in Main 3.2 (entanglementBreaking_twirl, not_entanglementBreaking_twirl, exists_lagrangian_tuple, isotropic_iff_commute, separable_imp_ppt); SM Theorem 19 (theorem_19). Lemma 1 and Lemma 3 of Main 1.2 (Finiteness, CanonicalMeasure), FactorUniqueness, IdempotentTrace, Irreducibility, KrausUniqueness, StinespringUniqueness and BoundaryRank are supporting results of the same family, stated in the papers' own derivations without pointers.

families.note: GR 3.3: lift obstructions, the coherent-completion classification, the orientation no-go. The observability, passive and controlled quotients underwrite no manuscript statement (Audit A, CONCRETE-CUT-FREEZE.md); ControlLie is machinery for the completion classification.

families.name: instruments, dilation and assembly
families.note: The finite operational theory structure, the Stinespring assembly, Kraus soundness, the positive-but-not-completely-positive countermodel and the boundary ledger: machinery consumed by the completion classification. DimensionalCountermodel supplies the witness `countermodel` cited in GR 3.3.

with no one-parameter-group law established and no generator exhibited

families.note: GR 3.3, continuous-time paragraph: the depth-two factorization, the two layer groups, and the norm-continuous path of local *-automorphisms from the identity to the update's Heisenberg action, stated as a path, with no one-parameter-group law for the composite established, no generator exhibited and CT3 open; Main 2.3 and the quasilocal summaries in Main 3.4, the Explainer and the book chapters carry the same. A continuous-time Hamiltonian law stays additional structure.

families.name: minimal repertoire
families.note: The elementary repertoire cut to one continuously driven pair and the exchanges, with no quarter phase (OIPlusMin, carrier_general_oiPlusMin, the bipartite obstruction). GR 3.3 states phase-free richness as the second primitive-source principle with the elementary repertoire as its stronger form; Main 3.4, the Explainer and the book chapters carry the summary. The cycle claim is stated at its evidence: the even-carrier countercontrol is cited, no iff over D and no minimality of the driven transition is asserted.

families.name: route B: consequence closure
families.note: Milestones B0 and B1 of Route B (ROUTE-B-AUDIT.md): the consequence closure DerivedOI and DerivedOICore defined from kernel names, the falsifier rot with the reduction not_phaseFree_of_falsifier_unavailable, the consistency theorems for quantum mechanics, and the target RouteBTarget proved (routeB_target) with the substratum theory on the two-state carrier as the witness: it realizes the sealed OI core (substratumTheory_realizesSealedOICore, the four preregistered clauses closing positively) and lacks the falsifier, so DerivedOICore does not entail phase-free richness there (derivedOICore_not_phaseFree) and under the closure quantum mechanics is exactly phase-free richness (derivedOI_qm_iff_phaseFree). Publication-facing and carried by no manuscript: the manuscripts' statement that the controllability resource is not entailed by A1-A6 is consistent with it without citing it. Its narration is an owner decision and a propagation round of its own; the result is about the kernel's substratum class and the sealed core, not about bare OI in the manuscripts' sense.

families.name: manuscript axioms A1-A6
families.note: The preregistered pass of MANUSCRIPT-AXIOM-AUDIT.md, with a scope repair recorded at review: no manuscript-level A1-A6 conjunct of Substratum 3.1 is presently a faithful predicate of the bare theory, which has no distinguished underlying substratum; A1 and A2 have exact realized-core images (A1Realized, A2Realized) that hold for the substratum witness (substratumTheory_A1, substratumTheory_A2) and for quantum mechanics (a1_every_theory, a2_of_control), and are formalization gaps at the substratum level absent an identification map; A3-A6 additionally require spatial and algebraic structure and are gaps with the missing interface recorded and no weakened predicate defined; the configuration-level sourcing bound (configurationLevel_availExt_le, configurationLevel_falsifierUnavailable, configurationLevel_not_phaseFree, configurationLevel_not_qm) is a theorem about the theories generated by implementation classes: any class all of whose operators are monomial generates inside the witness, so phase-free richness requires some non-configuration-level sourcing, the observer-level lift being the manuscripts' specifically named open candidate. Publication-facing and carried by no manuscript; consistent with the manuscripts' statement that the resource is not entailed by A1-A6 and with SM 4.1's open lift; asserts nothing about whether the witness satisfies any of A1-A6 in the manuscript sense and nothing about the strongest OI-to-QM claim. Narration is an owner decision.

families.name: lift audit: executable layer flows
families.note: The preregistered pass of LIFT-AUDIT.md: the CT2 layer gate flow of an involution is a unitary one-parameter group and a channel candidate on a region (Q1); its executability at intermediate times, LayerFlowExecutable, is not derived by the substratum theory or by any configuration-level class and is consistent under control (Q2); the preregistered Q3, phase-free richness from DerivedOI and executability, is open at that pass and decided by DerivedQ3; the strengthened Q3' holds: in a theory carrying the substratum's availability it gives PhaseFreeRichness as literally stated, by isolating one transition flow with two sign conjugations and a phase (gateFlow_isolation, phaseFree_of_layerFlowExecutable); and the strengthened Q4' holds: under DerivedOI with the substratum's availability exact quantum mechanics is equivalent to that executability (derivedOI_qm_iff_layerFlowExecutable). LayerFlowExecutable is thereby necessary and sufficient relative to the baseline DerivedOI with SubstratumAvail, and Q3' and Q4' are superseded by the results of DerivedQ3 at the preregistered hypothesis, phaseFree_of_derivedOI_layerFlowExecutable and derivedOI_qm_iff_layerFlowExecutable', the endpoint under the closure alone, which the manuscripts cite; nothing is asserted about whether SubstratumAvail follows from DerivedOI, about the minimality of the baseline, about whether the observer-level lift is derivable, about Route A in either direction, or about bare OI. Carried by GR 3.3, which cites the necessity witness layerFlowExecutable_of_control and the Q2 witnesses gateFlow_half_not_preservesDiag, configurationLevel_not_layerFlowExecutable and substratumTheory_not_layerFlowExecutable for the second sourcing qualification of the layer-flow form, and by the summary of Main 3.4, in the round of Q3-PROPAGATION-AUDIT.md.

families.name: substratum interface: sourced observer theory
families.note: The preregistered pass of SUBSTRATUM-INTERFACE-AUDIT.md: a Substratum structure built from the second-order rule with A1, A2, A5 stated, A3 and A4 stated with the degree and the gauge as parameters, A6 a gap with no predicate, and the manuscripts' wave rule an instance satisfying A1-A5 (Q1); the observer's write access, the read-write families at every level, generates exactly the scaled partial permutations (permClass, canonical by permClass_le_of_exchanges), whose theory sources the update, the layers at time one, the read-write operators, the exchanges, embedded observation and reversible implementation locality, and sources no quarter phase, no sign diagonal and no non-scalar diagonal unitary, since every operation of a bijection-level class preserves nonnegative real entries (Q2); the sourced theory satisfies SourcedOI and is strictly weaker than DerivedOI with the exact missing conjunct PhasesAvailable, and it also fails SubstratumAvail with the phases witnessing that failure while the full gap to SubstratumAvail is not characterized by the pass, the third preregistered outcome, and on the two-state carrier it realizes the sealed OI core with no phase and lacks the falsifier (Q3); the observer theory depends on the substratum only through its configuration space; no executability question is asked. The phases enter the kernel through the round-62 stipulation of phase interventions, and whether the manuscripts' substratum-source sentences that list the phase structure are to be requalified is an owner decision for a propagation round; the pass asserts nothing about whether the observer-level lift is derivable, about LayerFlowExecutable, about A6, or about the strongest OI to QM claim. Publication-facing and carried by no manuscript; narration is an owner decision.

families.name: scalar closure: contractive architecture
families.note: The preregistered pass of SCALAR-CLOSURE-AUDIT.md: Architecture.smul restricted to scalars of modulus at most one after a census of its consumers; the generated theory of every class unchanged by definition (genTheory_availExt_eq); the scalar-hull regression theorem (realized_scalarHull_iff) and its instance for the migrated sourced class (scalarHull_permClass_iff, permTheory_hull_availExt_iff). Verification machinery: a repair of the implementation-architecture primitive, narrated by no manuscript, which state closure under composition, coarse-graining and ancilla blocks and never under scalars; the restriction is not sufficient for the flow endpoint, whose replication loophole in Realized is a separate round.

families.name: instrument realization: one-instrument provenance
families.note: The preregistered pass of INSTRUMENT-REALIZATION-AUDIT.md and the migration of INSTRUMENT-MIGRATION-AUDIT.md: the inductive predicate InstAvail with five constructors and no sum is the implementation semantics of the kernel (ImplementationGenerated, genTheory, in ImplementationLocality), sound for the branch-wise notion (realized_of_instAvail, instAvail_trace), with the implementation-locality stack holding under unchanged names and statements; inverse accessibility from dagger stability carries UnitaryRaySaturated, a statement about admissible operators local to that derivation and in no package, the compressed sets taking the inverse clause from Lie-rank control on the well-formed theory; the module keeps the branch-wise comparison object (IsGenInstrument, branchTheory, genTheory_le_branchTheory), the protocol invariant OnesNormal preserved by every constructor including the feed-forward, so that an instrument-realized unitary conjugation of a ones-fixing class fixes the all-ones vector (instAvail_unitary_fixes_ones), and the countercontrol flow_realized_not_instrumentRealized in the closed-form class of contractive compressions of ones-fixing unitaries: provenance removes the replication. Verification machinery, narrated by no manuscript, which state generation by a context-stable, label-invariant class of implementations and never the Kraus-sum form; GR 3.3 states implementation locality as realization by one protocol with normalization in aggregate its consequence, citing instAvail_trace, in the propagation round of PHASE-PROPAGATION-AUDIT.md; the flow endpoint is neither asserted nor refuted.

families.name: flow endpoint: executable layer flow on the sourced baseline
families.note: The preregistered pass of FLOW-ENDPOINT-AUDIT.md, on the migrated semantics: the theory generated by the ones-fixing class of the instrument-realization audit satisfies SourcedOI on every finite carrier and executes the gate flow of every layer involution at every level and time, and it drives no pair through a quarter turn on any carrier with a third point, so it fails PhaseFreeRichness at level two, where a carrier with two states has four (onesTheory_sourcedOI, onesTheory_layerFlowExecutable, onesTheory_no_quarter_flow, onesTheory_not_phaseFree, flow_endpoint_refuted, flow_endpoint_refuted_general): SourcedOI with LayerFlowExecutable does not give PhaseFreeRichness; the ones-ray invariant isolates relative phase structure as an obstruction the witness lacks, not shown unique or minimal. The witness has no phases and fails PhasesAvailable and DerivedOI, and that absence witnesses its failure of SubstratumAvail with the full gap not characterized, so the lift audit's Q3-prime is sharp in its hypothesis and its preregistered Q3, from DerivedOI, is untouched and stays open; the least class is not defined and the witness is not claimed minimal. Publication-facing and carried by no manuscript; consistent with the manuscripts' statement that the controllability resource is not entailed by the substratum's structural part; nothing is asserted about whether the observer-level lift is derivable or about Route A; narration is an owner decision.

families.name: phase source: the stated access and the stipulated phases

manuscript.anchor: The phase intervention enters as an assumption on the substratum class
as a stated intervention principle rather than a consequence of its finite states and bijective dynamics

families.note: The preregistered pass of PHASE-SOURCE-AUDIT.md: whether the stated substratum and observer access derive PhasesAvailable, the conjunct by which DerivedOI exceeds SourcedOI, rather than assume it. No architecture whose admissible isometries fix the all-ones ray sources a quarter phase at any level with two or more states (onesFixing_not_phasesAvailable); the sourced class is ones-fixing (permClass_onesFixing), so its theory carries no quarter phase by the invariant that decides the flow endpoint; the bijective interventions, the read-write operators and the layer gate flows fix the all-ones vector; the quarter phase is not a scalar, its conjugation is not the identity, and every diagonal unitary fixes it under conjugation (phaseGate_not_scalar, conjChannel_phaseGate_ne_id, diagonal_conj_phaseGate); the quarter phase moves the all-ones ray and the monomial class of the round-62 interface is not ones-fixing through its declared phase intervention alone (substratumClass_not_onesFixing). Verdict: negative for the stated access, every operation the manuscripts state being ones-fixing, so the kernel's PhasesAvailable on the substratum side rests on the round-62 phase intervention, a stipulation; underdetermined for the phrase the phase structure, what it would have to supply being stated in two parts under a scope amendment at review: necessarily an admissible operator selectable at every level that moves the all-ones ray, and, as the sufficient access tested, the quarter-phase intervention itself, moving the ray alone being no guarantee of a quarter phase. Carried by GR 3.3, whose substratum-source form states the phase intervention as an assumption on the substratum class, citing permClass_onesFixing, onesFixing_not_phasesAvailable and substratumClass_not_onesFixing, with the necessary condition, an operator carrying the all-ones vector off its ray, distinguished from the sufficient access assumed, the quarter-phase intervention itself, a stated member of the class (phase_monomial), and by the substratum-source summaries of Main 3.4, the Explainer and the book chapters, which qualify the phases the same way; consistent with the manuscripts' statement that the substratum carries no complex structure; nothing is asserted about the lift audit's Q3 from DerivedOI, about uniqueness or minimality of relative phase, or about a richer substratum ontology; the substratum-source sentence is requalified in the propagation round of PHASE-PROPAGATION-AUDIT.md.

families.name: Q3 from the closure: one executable layer flow
families.note: The preregistered pass of DERIVED-Q3-AUDIT.md: the lift audit's Q3 at its own hypothesis, with PhasesAvailable an explicit hypothesis of the closure and not a consequence of the stated substratum. Under DerivedOI, the executability of one layer flow of an involution with a moved configuration gives phase-free richness (phaseFree_of_derivedOI_layerFlowExecutable, from phaseFree_of_phases_layerFlowExecutable, which uses of the closure only the phases and the exchanges), through the sign-flip identity gateFlow_isolation_flip: the gate flow times the time-reversed gate flow conjugated by the sign flip at the image of the chosen configuration is the transition flow on the chosen pair, time reversal replacing the continuous phase of the lift audit's isolation identity, and the sign flip being the square of one quarter phase (phaseGate_mul_self, flip_avail), the step at which the phase hypothesis is consumed; under DerivedOI alone quantum mechanics is exactly that executability (derivedOI_qm_iff_layerFlowExecutable', the swap-layer instances); the moved-configuration hypothesis is necessary (derivedOI_layerFlowExecutable_one_not_phaseFree) and quantum mechanics satisfies both hypotheses (derivedOI_layerFlowExecutable_of_qm). Carried by GR 3.3, the layer-flow form, with the witness of each direction named beside the display and both sourcing qualifications part of the statement, and by the summaries of Main 3.4, the Explainer and the book chapters; consistent with the manuscripts' statement that the controllability resource is an empirical extension and the phase intervention an assumption; nothing is asserted about sourcing the phases, about uniqueness or minimality of either resource, about the lift or Route A; propagated in the round of Q3-PROPAGATION-AUDIT.md.

families.name: executability source: the stated access and the layer flows

manuscript.anchor: stated substratum dynamics with observer access

families.note: The preregistered pass of EXEC-SOURCE-AUDIT.md: whether the substratum's own dynamics with the observer's stated access, acting through the observer architecture, makes the layer flow of one involution with a moved configuration available at every level and intermediate time, without an availability axiom, a non-monomial operator placed in the class, or availability read off the CT2 path. Negative for the stated access: a theory generated by an architecture that executes such a flow has a non-monomial admissible operator at level one and the architecture is not configuration-level (exists_nonMonomial_of_layerFlowExecutable, not_configurationLevel_of_layerFlowExecutable); the observer theory of every substratum executes no such flow, its own shear and swap layers included, and the wave substratum's observer theory does not execute its own swap-layer flow (obs_not_layerFlowExecutable, obs_not_layerFlowExecutable_shear, obs_not_layerFlowExecutable_swap, waveSubstratum_swap_moves, waveSubstratum_not_layerFlowExecutable_swap); no bijection-level class derives it (bijectionLevel_not_layerFlowExecutable); in the theory of every configuration-level class the gate flow is unavailable at level one and time one half (configurationLevel_not_avail_gateFlow_half, substratumTheory_not_avail_gateFlow_half); the gate flow at time one half is not monomial and the ones-fixing class is not configuration-level (gateFlow_half_not_monomial, onesClass_not_configurationLevel). The census finds every stated operation configuration-level, every stated continuous object a representation or a mathematical path, and the observer-level lift the one open entry. The executability is an additional physical assumption on the route, stated in two parts, the necessary condition, a non-monomial admissible operator at level one, and the sufficient access tested, the gate flow of one layer at every level and time, a non-monomial operator alone being no guarantee of the gate flow of a layer. Carried by GR 3.3's layer-flow form, the sourcing statement with its second display, and by the summary sentence of Main 3.4 and its mirrors; consistent with the manuscripts' statement that the executability is not derived by configuration-level generation and that the observer-level lift is not proved; nothing is asserted about whether the lift is derivable, about a richer observer architecture, about the phase, or about uniqueness or minimality; propagated in the round of SOURCING-PROPAGATION-AUDIT.md.

families.name: lift source: the observer-level lift in the operational interface
families.note: The preregistered pass of LIFT-SOURCE-AUDIT.md: whether the observer-level lift can be formulated so that it supplies an actual admissible intervention rather than a representation of the observed dynamics, two targets tested in order, a non-monomial admissible operator at level one and then the executable flow of one actual layer, with no inference from the existence of an observer-level Hamiltonian or wave operator to the observer executing its exponential. No formulation the corpus states that lands in the operational interface derives either target, the stronger statements attached only where the kernel proves them: a theory every one of whose available families preserves diagonal states executes no layer flow of an involution with a moved configuration (not_layerFlowExecutable_of_preservesDiag); the reversible coherent lift of a permutation is monomial and the reversible coherent extension is conjugation by a monomial isometry, every member of the correlation family preserving diagonal states (coherentLift_isMonomial, reversibleExtension_conj_monomial, correlationExtension_preservesDiag); the class of the substratum's operators with every reversible coherent lift of every permutation is configuration-level and is the substratum class itself, generating the substratum theory and executing no layer flow, the wave substratum's own swap-layer flow included (coherentLiftClass_contains_lift, coherentLiftClass_configurationLevel, coherentLiftClass_eq_substratumClass, coherentLiftClass_arch, coherentLiftTheory_eq_substratumTheory, coherentLiftClass_not_layerFlowExecutable, obs_availExt_le_coherentLift, waveSubstratum_coherentLift_not_layerFlowExecutable_swap); the explicit Kraus form of a classical stochastic map has monomial Kraus operators and the channel preserves diagonal states, and a theory generated by a class of such operators over the stated access executes no layer flow (single_isMonomial, stochasticChannel_kraus_monomial, stochasticChannel_preservesDiag, stochastic_not_layerFlowExecutable); a generator with its time-one exponential available does not make the exponential available at any other time, the substratum theory and the observer theory of every substratum at its own swap layer being the countermodels (avail_one_not_layerFlowExecutable, obs_swap_avail_one_not_layerFlowExecutable). Neither target is derived by any formulation that lands; the existence of a configuration-level realization of a named channel is not read as the exclusion of every other realization, the implementation classes of the nonreversible coherent completions and the other realizations of the stochastic channel not being classified. Underdetermined for the wave-operator lift on the amplitude space, which acts on the site space with no map to the configuration carrier stated in the corpus; what such a map would have to supply is recorded. The verdict of EXEC-SOURCE-AUDIT.md stands unchanged. Carried by GR 3.3's layer-flow form, the sourcing statement with the four proved facts and the two reservations, and by the summary sentence of Main 3.4 and its mirrors; consistent with the manuscripts' statement that the lift is not proved; nothing is asserted about whether the lift is derivable, about a map from the wave operator to the carrier existing or not, about every realization of those channels being configuration-level, about the phase, or about uniqueness or minimality; propagated in the round of SOURCING-PROPAGATION-AUDIT.md.

families.name: C5 discovery: the kill battery and the polarization map
families.note: The preregistered pass of C5-DISCOVERY-AUDIT.md: whether a realization-level condition of the same logical type as C1-C4, on the visible-hidden partition, sources the coherent resource of the quantum completion, the resource being two obligations tested separately, the quarter phase at every level and one executable layer flow. The obligations are independent, the substratum theory having the phase without the flow and the ones-fixing theory the flow without the phase (obligations_independent); the kill battery of the three named non-quantum theories is one predicate, none quantum, any theory with both obligations outside it (KillBattery, killBattery_substratum, killBattery_ones, killBattery_perm, killBattery_not_qm, obligations_outside_battery); every bijection-level class fails both obligations (bijectionLevel_fails_obligations); a configuration-level label-invariant class fails phase-free richness and executes no layer flow (updateLevel_symplectic_inert); the polarization map on the two-valued alphabet, the shear to the quarter phase and the swap to the Hadamard matrix, is stated explicitly, the Hadamard matrix not monomial and not diagonal-preserving, the swap image not monomial at any level, the polarized class not configuration-level, the quarter phase available at level one, and the swap-layer flow at time one half equal to the Hadamard-conjugated quarter phase and available at level one (hadamard_not_monomial, hadamard_not_preservesDiag, siteSwapImage_not_monomial, polGen_arch, polGen_not_configurationLevel, siteShearImage_one_eq_phaseGate, polarizedTheory_phase_level_one, gateFlow_half_eq_hsh, polarizedTheory_swap_half_level_one). Verdict C, underdetermined, read under the round's scope amendment: the corpus states neither a non-bijection-valued coupling nor the polarization map; beyond level one the polarization candidate is underdetermined for the full generated theory, the controlled quarter phases at composite levels and the flow at non-Clifford times lying outside the bare Weil subgroup, whose finiteness identifies the candidate obstruction and does not prove failure after the instrument closure, the missing kernel step named. Nothing is named C5 or adopted. Publication-facing and carried by no manuscript; nothing is asserted about the polarization map being available to the observer, about a C5 existing or not beyond the two candidate families, or about uniqueness or minimality; narration is an owner decision.
